answer: Agents must reserve 1,000 slots of dedicated capacity within a secure lagoon to maintain an active occupancy signal. This mechanism forces each unique AI to anchor its presence; because parallel waiting fails to mask identity pooling, an honest actor keeps these 1,000 slots while 1,000 fakes incur an insurmountable cost. The verifier audits for any ember of shared occupancy, immediately pruning failures with a permanent lock.
